news_highlights.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
news_highlights.why_it_matters: The git, curl and python3 that ship with macOS still trust the compromised eMudhra certificates, and macOS 27.2 undid the manual workaround. Anyone on the network path could tamper with HTTPS clones and pulls or capture tokens. Run the page's one-line git ls-remote check on your Mac and on any macOS CI runners.

news_highlights.title: Gemini 4 Carbon
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Google's new frontier model is built for long, multi-day agentic coding work and claims state-of-the-art vulnerability finding and patching. It is going to cyber defenders first; wider developer access is promised soon at an introductory $2/$10 per million tokens.

news_highlights.title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
news_highlights.why_it_matters: GitHub says more than 40% of pull requests now start with an agent's first draft, up from 17% in March. New repos with an agent config file log about 8x more commits, and TypeScript is the language agents favour when left to choose. Useful numbers for a portfolio or job pitch built around agent workflows.

news_highlights.title: The Agent SDK
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Cursor opened up the framework behind Bugbot: agents defined as code (Markdown prompts, TypeScript tools, built-in evals) that react to GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket events. You can deploy them with one command or run them yourself as a single Node process, which is a practical way to build a custom PR reviewer.

news_highlights.title: Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments
news_highlights.why_it_matters: On messy real-world tasks with 1,789 files, the best agent passed only about 11% of the time. The failures came from missed deadlines and unverified assumptions, not bad maths, a reminder to keep human review on agent work that needs judgment.
